title: The Dogs of Salem
sentences: Even two dogs were killed during the Salem panic.
Many Puritans believed witches could work through animals.
In Andover, an afflicted girl accused a neighbor’s dog of bewitching her, and it was shot.
In Salem Village, another dog began acting strangely.
The afflicted girls said a man named John Bradstreet was riding it with his spirit.
The dog was killed anyway, and Bradstreet fled the colony.
caption:
Even two dogs were killed during the Salem witch panic.
